//: Used in: components/instagram/InstagramPermissionSheet (instagramPermission namespace). Opened on connect error 4099 (insights permission missing / personal account).
title: Allow insights access
intro: Your Instagram connected, but without the insights permission Tagly can't work out your rewards.
readsBody: Tagly reads how many people your story reached and uses that number to calculate what you earn.
privacyBody: Tagly never posts, messages anyone, or changes anything on your account, and it can't see your password or DMs.
